lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-lateral flank. Clusters are smaller and more densely packed near the anterior portion, expanding in size and spacing as they progress posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed crossing the horizontal paths of the blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibit a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and low-luminance shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small elongated high-luminance silhouette is visible in close proximity to the ventral-posterior edge of the primary pectoral fin.
